articles.title: Crypto's second U.S. lobbying front — tax policy — sees industry push on mining, staking
articles.snippet: The crypto sector's leading U.S. advocacy groups asked the U.S. House's tax committee to advance a bill to clarify treatment of assets from mining and staking.

articles.title: XRP briefly loses $1.14 support before buyers drive sharp rebound
articles.snippet: Heavy selling pushed XRP to its lowest level of the weekend session, but strong buying quickly erased most of the decline and returned the token to its recent trading range.

articles.title: Bitcoin holds near $64,000 as US-Iran talks progress but crypto sits out the rally
articles.snippet: Asian stocks and tech climbed as the US and Iran agreed a roadmap to a final peace deal, sending oil below $80. Crypto stayed soft, with bitcoin down 2% on the week and the memecoins leading the losses.

articles.title: Ethereum's biggest 'sandwich' bot drained of $7.5 million in ironic exploit
articles.snippet: Blockaid said an attacker tricked Jaredfromsubway.eth into approving fake trading routes, then used those approvals to drain WETH, USDC and USDT.

articles.title: Enso launches RWA app and trading for over 500 tokenized assets
articles.snippet: Enso launched access to over 500 tokenized assets and US stocks, citing a growing demand for US equity exposure among European investors.
